title: Upgrade to v1.23.0 (Pruning Fix + Content Tag Normalization)
summary: Fixes state-sync pruning bug where pruneSnapshotHeights[0]=0 prevented IAVL pruning from advancing past snapshotInterval-1. Adds content tag normalization (porn -> adult alias). Includes startup PebbleDB compaction for disk reclamation, reduced log retention (90 -> 30 days), and removal of obsolete GoLevelDB converter. No on-chain state migration required.
